profile: Anika Therapeutics develops products using proprietary hyaluronic acid technology, with a focus on osteoarthritis pain management and regenerative solutions in orthopedics. Its portfolio includes single- and multi-injection viscosupplement products for osteoarthritis pain relief, generally administered in an office setting, and a scaffold system designed for rotator cuff and other tendon repairs. In the United States, Johnson & Johnson MedTech markets its Monovisc and Orthovisc products.
